nodes.label: ADR-0002: Grok/Gemini as dev model providers
nodes.rationale: No Anthropic key yet: router resolves ANTHROPIC>XAI>GEMINI from env. Addendum: xAI had $0 credits, so a second 'openai' API shape was added with Gemini free tier as first provider — this became the general adapter for Groq/OpenRouter later.
